summary: Comprehensive P5 testing completed for ZOZO Burger. Fixed critical Pydantic v2 compatibility issue in backend. All backend APIs (18/18) and frontend features tested successfully. Minor issues identified: SendGrid email mocked (401), ExpertOrder in test mode.

resolved_bugs.issue: Backend server crashing due to Pydantic v2 incompatibility
resolved_bugs.fix: Updated PyObjectId to use __get_pydantic_core_schema__ instead of deprecated __modify_schema__

resolved_bugs.issue: UnboundLocalError in order creation when loyalty system fails

known_limitations.impact: Email confirmations not sent, but order creation works
known_limitations.note: API key needs to be completed tomorrow as mentioned in agent context

known_limitations.impact: Orders not sent to production POS

design_observations.observation: Dark theme with red/white accents looks professional and premium
Visual burger preview with layers is excellent UX
Smart upselling after adding items (e.g., 'Noch was Süßes dazu?')

passed_tests: ✅ Backend: All 18 API endpoints (100% success rate)
✅ Homepage: Hero section, featured products carousel, location cards with opening status
✅ Location Selection: PLZ-based branch assignment working
✅ Menu Page: Categories, products, search, filters all functional
✅ Product Customizer: Extras, removals, bun selection, menu upgrade with sides/drinks
✅ Burger Builder: Complete 5-step flow with live preview (bun, patty, toppings, sauces, finalize)
✅ Cart & Checkout: Add to cart, quantity controls, delivery zone validation, payment methods
✅ Loyalty System: Points display, redemption slider in checkout
✅ Order Tracking: Search by order number, status display with progress bar
✅ Rewards Page: Loyalty points, achievements, transaction history
✅ Admin Dashboard: Stats display, order management, status updates
✅ Mobile Responsiveness: All pages render correctly on mobile (390x844)
✅ Quick Reorder: Order history retrieval working
✅ Deals & Promotions: Admin can create and manage deals
